subject: angol
title: A day at work
situation: Last week your school organised a careers day, and you spent a whole day at a workplace to see what a job is really like. You write a blog in English for your friends from abroad. Write a post about your day.
situationHu: A pályaorientációs napon egy egész napot töltöttél egy munkahelyen; írj róla bejegyzést az angol nyelvű blogodba.

points.text: say where you spent the day and what job you learnt about
describe what the people there did and what you helped with
say whether you would like to do this job in the future and why

usefulPhrases.en: I spent the day at … with …
My aunt works as a vet.
I was allowed to help with …
It was harder / more interesting than I expected.
usefulPhrases.hu: Nehezebb / érdekesebb volt, mint amire számítottam.

usefulPhrases.en: to work long hours / to work in a team
I'd love to be a … one day because …

modelAnswer.text:
Hi everyone!

Last week our school organised a careers day, and I spent the whole day at a local newspaper in Győr. I wanted to find out what being a journalist is really like.

The office was much busier than I expected. First the journalists discussed the next day's stories, and then they spent hours interviewing people and writing articles. I was allowed to go with a photographer to the opening of a new café, and later I helped to write a report about it.

I'd love to become a journalist one day because I enjoy writing and meeting new people. The deadlines are stressful, but I think it's an exciting job.

Bye for now!

I'd love to become a journalist one day because I enjoy writing and meeting new people.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a munkahely és a szakma, a dolgozók napja és a saját feladatod, végül az indokolt jövőbeli döntés – mindhárom szempont konkrét, részletes.
Hangnem: a külföldi barátoknak szóló blog közvetlen („Hi everyone!”, „Bye for now!”, összevont alakok), de világos és udvarias.
Szövegalkotás: időrendi kapcsolóelemek (First, and then, later) vezetik az olvasót, a „but” pedig ellenpontot ad a véleményhez.
Szókincs és nyelvhelyesség: B1-es, pontos szerkezetek – középfokú hasonlítás (much busier than I expected), „was allowed to”, „spend hours + -ing”.
Érdemes megtanulni: „find out what … is really like”, „much busier than I expected”, „I was allowed to …”, „I'd love to become … one day because …”.
